up_axis: y (floor of Waterworld is y=0; normals of floors are (0,+1,0))
method: gbox.re4_switch_assets.pack_slots on st4/<room>.udas; slot 1 ext "SAT" parsed by the offsets in the .md; helper scripts outside system/gbox

floor: the cell centre lies under a collision triangle with normal.y >= 0.5, and no wall segment crosses the cell
grid_cell_chars.#: blocked: a wall segment (see wall_rule) crosses a cell that has floor, or the cell centre lies under a wall triangle and no floor
grid_cell_chars.space: outside: no floor triangle under the cell centre

wall_rule: collision triangles with |normal.y| < 0.5 (steeper than 60 deg from level) and vertical extent (max y - min y) > 1000 mm; each as one 2D segment (x0,z0,x1,z1) = the triangle projected onto its horizontal tangent through its xz centroid; duplicates (either direction, rounded to 1 mm) removed

ram_samples_mm.from_docs: docs/research/re4-switch-ram.md: (-3809.2, 41.6, 5961.0) and (-3668, 41, 6021); nav note x=50689 (room label not verified)

frame_check.r400_floor_under_ram_sample: cell is floor; SAT floor height there 0 mm vs RAM y 41.6 mm (see md)
frame_check.verdict: up axis is y in both. Shared origin: consistent with r400 only (the two RAM samples land on a floor cell in r400 and outside the grid of r402/r403/r404); not proven for the others (no RAM sample known for them)
